title: Knight’s Request
paragraphs: “Liberation Prominence X!”
My sun-like flames engulf the research facility. A small sun appeared in the sky, sending down a pillar of fire as it descended.
“Drifa Tornado X!”

Itsuki cast a tornado spell that seemed like something Filo-tan would chant. The center of the vortex seemed to have become a vacuum. I could see that it was drawing in the flames from my Prominence, increasing its power.
“Ren can’t step in here, so… Queen!”
“Understood. Liberation Lightning X!”
The Queen then cast a spell that brought down a storm of lightning. Lightning… That was the specialty of Older Sister, wasn’t it?
“Alright! Once the three spells are done, the others will use ritual magic. Ren, unleash your power to the limit!”
Father gave attack orders. There wasn’t much else he could do. Once the effects of our spells wore off, a moment of stillness followed.
“Drifa Blizzard X!”
Ren’s ice magic activated, and a blizzard enveloped the research facility.
“Here we go! Choral Magic ‘Tornado’!”

Yuki-chan combined her power with Kou and Sakura-chan to summon a massive tornado. The power of Ren’s Blizzard increased dramatically. Amazing. I could clearly see how Father’s orders were enhancing the magic.
“I understand what Naofumi wants! That’s why Gaelion will join in too!”

‘I, Gaelion, summon the power and call for its manifestation. Dragon veins, grant me strength!’ Recalling the teamwork from the decisive battle in Melromarc, Rival synchronized perfectly with Assistant and Mole. ‘As the source of power, I command. Combine your strength with the flowing water!’ “Choral Magic ‘Avalanche D-Breath!’” This time, Rival transformed into a semi-liquid dragon and spewed out a debris-filled torrent, leaning heavily into the water attribute. As for Éclair, who had been a bit subdued lately… oh? It seems she was contributing her strength to the ritual magic. So, she wasn’t just a bystander. With the layers of magic raining down, a massive crater formed where the research facility had once stood.
“Phew… Did that take care of it?”
“Probably… but it’s too soon to let our guard down, isn’t it?”
“Yeah. Just to be sure, we should attack deep underground as well… Wasn’t the ritual magic ‘Sanctuary’ supposed to be effective?”
“Then, let’s cast it.”
In the end, thanks to repeatedly layering magic as if to ensure total eradication, the rampaging bio-plant was completely destroyed.
“Seriously… It’s exhausting having one troublesome incident after another.”

Father looked quite tired. After receiving the final report, it was promised that the researcher’s facility would be rebuilt. Not only did the monsters obediently follow the researcher’s orders, but they also helped rescue the researchers who had been left behind, turning the story into a heartwarming tale.

As expected, the misdeeds of the Homunculus Lab and Takt’s faction, who had caused such a major incident, were made known to the public. We’ve now reached a point where anything that happens is automatically attributed to Takt’s faction’s wrongdoings. It’s a good era, indeed.
“They said it was a useful seed… but now it’s gone.”
“Indeed. In the original world and even in other worlds, it was a miracle plant that could solve food shortages.”
“Sigh… I guess worsening food conditions can’t be helped…”
“If Motoyasu has the skill, perhaps he can replicate it with ordinary plants.”
“Gaelion will help too!”
“I’ll pass on that.”
Working with Rival? I’d rather die.
“With Motoyasu-kun?”
“No, not Gaelion… um… someone else will do it.”
Rival mumbled awkwardly, then whispered something into Father’s ear. For a brief moment, Rival’s face twisted with the expression of a troubled parent.
“Wyndia-chan, dragons can breed with any kind of monster, right?”
“Huh? Yeah, that’s what I’ve heard.”
“Even with plant-type monsters…? That’s amazing…”
“Huh? Gaelion, are you going to lay eggs?”
“Gaelion only lays eggs with Naofumi.”
Assistant tilted her head in confusion. It looks like the parent is the one being forced into this.
“F-For now, Motoyasu-kun. If modifying ordinary plants doesn’t work, I’m counting on you.”

Ugh… Father is giving me a harsh order. In that case, I have no choice but to do it. And so, I ended up with the task of collecting plants to recreate the bio-plant. On the fifth day of development, I finally managed to recreate something by using a highly prolific plant as a base. Fine-tuning the detailed status was a major hurdle. Ordinary plants are fragile and require delicate handling. If I failed, they would break apart. The alchemist who created the original bio-plant must have been a monster on par with the researcher. And so, with all that going on, we continued our training and studies in preparation for the next wave.
…It feels like I’m forgetting something. Blue sea… white sandy beach—
Huh? The Pig King is calling for us, so we’re heading over.
“Huh? A consultation from the castle knights?”
“Bufufufufu… Yes. It seems that for the past few months, they’ve been feeling a certain unease. They’ve come to consult us, thinking that perhaps the Four Holy Heroes might be able to resolve it.”
“Haa…” Father responded with a hollow, unenthusiastic reply, as if he had no idea what was going on.
“Bufufufu… I don’t really understand it myself. You’d best ask the knights for the details. Farewell then.”
The Pig King ended the audience rather quickly. As always, he was an elite pig. Being straightforward and keeping conversations short is one of his virtues.
“This request doesn’t quite make sense, does it?”
“Indeed. They’re talking about some kind of unease, but they haven’t even mentioned the specifics of the job, and yet they’re already making arrangements?”
“Is everyone this sloppy?”
We just dealt with a magical hazard recently. We’re all still in a tired mood.
“Umm… about the current request, it concerns a woman who is a distant member of the royal family. Three knights tasked with her protection have come forward with a consultation.”
“Ah, so the details were properly reported.”
“The problem was on the king’s side, huh…”
Father and the others responded with mild exasperation.
“So? What’s this feeling of unease?”
“The representative of the knights is waiting. This way, please.”
We were led to a reception room where a man clad in black armor was seated, waiting for us. Father and the others looked at the knight’s face and seemed a bit taken aback. What’s the matter?
“What is it? He’s… very handsome?”
“A real beauty, isn’t he?”
“Tall and handsome…”
Ah, they’re intimidated by his good looks? No need to worry. Father and the others are just as impressive. Judging people by appearance alone is the mark of a pig.
“But thanks to being around Motoyasu-kun, I’m pretty used to it.”
“Indeed. There aren’t many as good-looking as Motoyasu-san.”
“True. But if this guy starts ending his sentences with ‘I say,’ I’m leaving this to Naofumi and walking out.”
“Ren… come on now… well, whatever.”
What’s so wrong with ‘I say’?
“So, you’re the knight who came for a consultation?”
When I spoke in an unnecessarily pompous tone, the knight stood up and introduced himself.
“I-I am Rollick Itovis. It’s an honor to meet the Four Holy Heroes!”
Oh, a flawless salute. Even Éclair was compelled to return the salute.
“I am Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero.”
“I am Ren Amaki, the Sword Hero.”
“I am Itsuki Kawasumi, the Bow Hero.”
“The Love Hunter—”
“This person is Motoyasu Kitamura, the Spear Hero.”
Father cut me off. Lately, it feels like Father and the others have been able to predict my actions in advance.
“I-I look forward to working with you.”
Hmm… this knight… he has no openings. He’s quite capable. That said, I don’t sense any hostility. He really does seem to be here for a consultation.
“For now, standing while we talk is a bit much. Let’s sit down.”
“Y-Yes.”
Following Ren’s words, Father and the knights sat down on the sofa. This feels like a job interview.
